name: Verifed V25
description: Applies Apple UI readability and touch tips: small labels at least 11 points, larger guest/menu/edit/save/source/close targets, more caption line spacing and stronger missing-photo text contrast. Oliur-inspired aesthetic changes remain pending approval.
verification: 174 automated tests passed; iOS, Android and web exports succeeded.
Source review found and raised 21 text styles below 11 points. Targeted controls use minimum dimensions without disabling native text scaling.
Taco Bell missing-photo label contrast increased from 2.80:1 to 5.54:1 against its light photo canvas.
No Oliur-inspired border, spacing, layout or copy redesign is included.
Physical iPhone and native camera/permission behavior remain unverified.

Android Expo Go loaded Welcome, guest Home and Chipotle; the dietary Edit action opened profile settings. Screens were inspected with emulator font_scale configured to 1.0 and 1.3; the original setting was restored. This does not establish iOS Dynamic Type compliance.
All 379 Snack asset hashes were verified; the published editor returned HTTP 200 with the V25 title. Remote Snack runtime was not tested. ZIP comparison remains unavailable: SNACK_DOWNLOAD_TOO_LARGE.
